infoSections.title: Theory source and trust positioning
infoSections.text: Drivest keeps its theory positioning explicit so learners know what is original practice content and what remains official elsewhere.
bullets: Theory questions are Drivest-created practice content for learning support.
Drivest is not affiliated with DVSA and does not claim DVSA-licensed theory questions unless that is expressly stated.
English Peek, explanations, and source references are learning support rather than official test authority.

faq.title: Theory preparation questions
faq.intro: These are the key questions learners usually ask before they move from revision into practice.

items.q: Can I study in another language and still check the English wording?
items.a: Yes. Drivest supports theory preparation across 32 supported languages and lets learners use English Peek on the same question when they want to compare wording.

items.q: Do I need to start practical lessons before using Drivest theory prep?
items.a: No. Drivest is designed so future learners can begin theory, road signs, Highway Code, and fines preparation before practical lessons begin.

items.q: What theory topics are included in the theory hub?
items.a: The theory hub links together theory questions, mock tests, Highway Code revision, road signs, fines learning, and the visible Hazard Perception path.
No. Drivest theory questions are Drivest-created practice content for learning support. Drivest is independent and does not claim DVSA-licensed theory questions unless that is expressly stated.

infoSections.title: Important route positioning
infoSections.text: Practice routes are reconstructed for learning support only.
bullets: Routes are reconstructed or generated for learning and are not official driving test routes.
Learners must always follow live road signs, road markings, and traffic laws.
Navigation, route, and parking outputs are advisory only and may be incomplete or delayed.

infoSections.title: Route trust and reporting
infoSections.text: Practice pages expose route trust signals and let learners report gaps when data needs review.
bullets: Route trust metadata can include review date, version, difficulty, source class, confidence, and key challenges.
Learners can report closures, stale details, unsafe guidance, impossible turns, and other route issues.
Missing-centre and request-another-route flows can flag coverage gaps.
Completed practice can feed usefulness and currentness feedback into route review.

faq.title: Practice-route questions
faq.intro: These are the core questions learners ask before using centre pages and local route practice.

items.q: Are Drivest practice routes official driving test routes?
items.a: No. Drivest routes are reconstructed or generated for learning support only and must not be described as official driving test routes.

items.q: How should I use practice routes around a test centre?
items.a: Use them for local familiarity, repetition, and route planning support. Always follow live road signs, markings, traffic laws, and any instructor or examiner instruction.

items.q: Why is a centre shown on the public Drivest site?
items.a: Public centre pages are shown only when the published dataset has enough route depth to make local practice useful.

items.q: Can I report a bad or missing route?
items.a: Yes. Practice users can report stale information, closures, unsafe guidance, or impossible turns, and can also flag a missing centre or request another route where coverage is incomplete.

faq.title: Pricing questions
faq.intro: These are the main commercial questions users ask before choosing a Drivest plan.

items.q: What is included in Free Learning?
items.a: Free Learning covers theory-first preparation and onboarding so future learners and current learners can begin before paying for centre practice or annual driving support.
Selected-Centre Practice is a monthly plan tied to one chosen test centre, with reconstructed practice routes, off-route alerts, and offline packs while the subscription stays active.

items.q: Do annual driving-support plans include practice routes for the full year?
items.a: Not always. The annual bundle includes one month of selected-centre practice, while the annual driving-support entitlement continues on its own yearly timeline.

items.q: Are practice routes official driving test routes?
items.a: No. Practice routes are reconstructed or generated for learning support only and are not official driving test routes.

safety.title: Safety and trust
bullets: Real-world driving, lessons, bookings, and navigation must follow UK legal requirements.
Drivest guidance is advisory only and may be incomplete or delayed.
Practice routes are reconstructed for learning and are not official driving test routes.
Keep full control of the vehicle and always follow live road signs, road markings, and traffic laws.
Do not interact with the app while driving.
Independent instructors remain responsible for their own lessons, licences, insurance, and legal compliance.
arrivalAdvisory: Parking outputs are advisory only and may not reflect live restrictions.
Check local signage and restrictions before leaving the vehicle.

faq.a: Drivest provides future learner and learner preparation tools, reconstructed practice routes, advisory navigation support, parking guidance, progress tracking, subscriptions, and, where enabled, instructor marketplace and booking features.

faq.q: Is Drivest only for people already taking lessons?
faq.a: No. Drivest is also positioned for future learner driver preparation. Users can begin theory, Highway Code, traffic signs, and fines preparation early before practical lessons begin.
No. Drivest is an independent product and has no affiliation with the Driver and Vehicle Standards Agency or any government authority.

faq.q: Are Drivest theory questions official DVSA exam questions?
faq.a: No. Drivest theory questions are Drivest-created practice content for learning support unless a page expressly states otherwise.

faq.q: Are Drivest routes official driving test routes?
faq.a: No. Routes are reconstructed or generated for learning and practice only and must never be described as official test routes.

faq.q: Can I study in another language and still check the English question?
faq.a: Yes. Drivest supports theory learning across 32 supported languages. Learners can study in a preferred language and use English Peek to compare the same question in English when they want extra certainty.

faq.q: Can I rely on Drivest as the final authority while driving?
faq.a: No. Users must always follow live road signs, real-world conditions, traffic laws, and any instruction from an instructor, examiner, police officer, or other authority.

faq.q: Does Drivest guarantee parking legality or availability?
faq.a: No. Parking outputs are advisory only. Users must check local signage and local restrictions before leaving a vehicle.

faq.q: What subscription plans does Drivest offer?
faq.a: Drivest offers an annual navigation plan, an annual navigation plan bundled with one month of practice route access for one selected test centre, and a monthly practice routes plan. Free learning and onboarding access remain available before upgrading.

faq.q: Do practice routes last for the full bundled annual subscription period?
faq.a: Not always. Under the bundled annual navigation and limited practice route plan, navigation continues for the annual period but route access for the chosen centre expires after one month unless extended through a separate purchase.

Where marketplace features are enabled, Drivest may allow learners to discover instructors, review availability, request a lesson, and complete payment through the platform. The lesson itself remains a contract between the learner and the instructor, and any booking terms are shown before confirmation.

faq.q: What is the lesson cancellation policy?
faq.a: Where booking features are enabled, cancellation handling is shown in the relevant booking flow before confirmation. Learners should review the displayed terms for the specific lesson request because availability, payment timing, and cancellation handling can vary by enabled flow.
Drivest may carry out limited checks for platform integrity, but it does not certify or guarantee instructor qualifications or status unless this is expressly stated.

Depending on the features used, Drivest may process account details, device and technical data, learning progress, route activity, booking records, payment metadata, consent records, review content, dispute evidence, and audit logs.

faq.q: Does Drivest track my location all the time?
faq.a: No. Location is used where route, hazard, or parking features require it and where device permission is granted. Drivest does not store continuous background location history on its servers unless that is clearly disclosed in a future version.
No. Drivest does not sell personal data for advertising or marketing purposes.

A learner or instructor may submit a dispute through the platform where available. Drivest may review the available record, including logs, timestamps, payment data, and evidence, and may make a platform decision such as no action, refund, restriction, or suspension.

faq.q: How do I request access to or deletion of my data?
faq.a: Email admin@drivest.uk with the request details. Identity verification may be required before action is taken.
